visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Heading is not centred
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The heading should sit in the middle of the page but stays on the left. The rule uses a value that does not exist, so the browser ignores it.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Our story

solution.code: Our story
solution.explanation: The value for horizontal alignment is center, not middle. An unknown value makes the whole declaration invalid, so the default (left) stays and no error is shown.
